Description: Unique number of the track (individual cell or group of merged/split cells) that each feature belongs to after merge/split post-processing; the same as feature_parent_track_id in the dataset output. Features not part of a track get the track_number_unassigned value (-1 by default).
Time elapsed since the first feature of the track. NaT for features not part of a track.
True for the last feature of a cell that ends with a merge into another cell.
True for the first feature of a cell that starts with a split from another cell.
